Name: Magic Scarecrows
Author: Niteslash
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3gH6BJP.png[/img]

[size=3]Magic Scarecrows adds a unique scarecrow to Stardew Valley.

Though it functions like any normal scarecrow, the Nature Ward Scarecrow comes fully animated, will act as a lightsource, and will change appearance depending on the season! Keep those pesky crows away with over-the-top totemic magic.
[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8jGKDMA.gif[/img]           [img]https://i.imgur.com/uedYMw1.gif[/img]           [img]https://i.imgur.com/SLnUljI.gif[/img]           [img]https://i.imgur.com/dvWSeb4.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]Spring - Summer - Fall - Winter

[/b][/size][/center][center][size=3]You can acquire the recipe in-game by reaching two hearts with everybody's favourite wizard, after which he will send the recipe by mail.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NdMvVJK.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NdMvVJK.png[/img]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/Wnfh6Nt.png[/img]


The recipe requires the following:

[/size][/center][center][size=3][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/tkw2BSs.png[/img] 50 Wood
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JUP7GAr.png[/img] 5 Fiber
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CKVl2s0.png[/img] 1 Solar Essence


[/b][/size][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/xC1xuUm.png[/img]

[size=3][b]1: [/b]Make sure you have installed the [b]requirements[/b] at the top of this page.
[b]2: [/b]Unzip the folder into[b] [/b][i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i][b] [/b]or download using[b] mod manager.[/b]



[/size][/center][center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/y8fKh26.png[/img]

[/size][size=3]If using the excellent [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15290]Immersive Scarecrows[/url]﻿ mod, the scarecrows will not update their appearance when the season changes if they are placed in between tiles. You will have to remove them and place them down a couple of times to get them to update.

I know they look like trees, and crows like trees, but it's [color=#9900ff][b]magic[/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4], okay!?[i] Yoba...[/i][/color]﻿[/size][/center]
